changes: v2 (29 Sep 2026, after the first v2 and v3 runs; compare.cjs re-scores every run with these rules): dice-8 accepts the spoken fraction 'five thirty-sixths' (a correct v2 answer). christmas-day's wrong-day rule no longer fires on the Tuesday restated from the question ('Starting from Tuesday, September 29' - a correct v3 answer); it flags any other weekday, or Tuesday tied to December 25. not-enough-time also rejects a contradicting 'N minutes left for gaming'. score.cjs reads '**-5**' written with an en dash or maths minus as -5. v3 (30 Sep, after the v3 h2 run): christmas-day's wrong-day rule only looks at the day given for December 25 - it had fired again on a correct 'Friday' answer that also said, truly, that January 1, 2026 was a Thursday.
about: Harder reasoning: multi-step word problems where the setup is the hard part, classic traps, logic puzzles, probability, calendar and clock reasoning. Built 29 Sep 2026 to measure the 'thinking power' upgrade (workflow v3) against v2. Same rules as tasks.json: 'opt' may inform changes, 'holdout' only judges them.

tasks.prompt: A train leaves Calgary at 2:15 pm going 90 km/h toward Edmonton, 300 km away. Another leaves Edmonton at 2:45 pm going 110 km/h toward Calgary on the same line. At what time do they meet? Round to the nearest minute.
I am three times as old as my cousin. In 10 years I will be twice as old as my cousin. How old am I now?

Four players - Ana, Bo, Cy and Di - wear jerseys 1, 2, 3 and 4, one each. Ana's number is odd. Bo's number is one more than Cy's. Di's number is greater than Ana's. Cy's number is not 1. Bo's number is even. What number does each player wear?
I have 3 hours after school. Homework takes 75 minutes, soccer practice takes 90 minutes including travel, and dinner takes 20 minutes. How many minutes are left for gaming?
A jacket costs $50. Its price goes up 20% and then the new price goes down 20%. What is the final price, and is it higher or lower than $50?
I roll two normal six-sided dice. What is the probability that the sum is 8? Give it as a fraction.
I can clean the garage in 3 hours. My brother takes 6 hours. If we work together, how long will it take?
My dad's car uses 8.5 litres per 100 km. A road trip is 340 km and gas costs $1.45 per litre. How much will the gas cost, to the cent?
I bike 60 km at 30 km/h and then another 60 km at 90 km/h. What is my average speed for the whole trip?
September 29, 2026 is a Tuesday. What day of the week is December 25, 2026?
How many different 3-person committees can be chosen from a class of 8 students?
I earn $12.50 an hour. I work 3.5 hours on Saturday and 4 hours on Sunday. I put 15% of my pay into savings and then spend $40. How much spending money do I have left, to the cent?
What is the next number in this sequence: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ... ?
A rectangle has a perimeter of 54 cm, and its length is twice its width. What is its area?
What is the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 3:40?

Three students - Kai, Lea and Max - have lockers 10, 11 and 12, one each. Kai's locker number is even. Lea's locker is right next to Kai's. Max's locker is not number 12. What is each student's locker number?
